threads.body: Does this also cover test classpath? We had the same issue with testing-commons dependency. There we worked around this by replacing the usual project dependency with `io.opentelemetry.javaagent:opentelemetry-testing-common` and dependency substitute it with `project(":testing-common:with-shaded-dependencies")`. If this works well I’d imagine we could get rid of that too.

replies.body: yes it does cover the test classpath. Removing that old workaround caused intellij to no longer recognize some of the armeria classes, so i needed to add [this](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/pull/20318/changes#diff-32fae187af6b6c32f8e4aaa3725e1ddf644d6c46ca6383f5f547b1d58f240205R23)
That might not work with test suites, if it doesn't then might be better to keep the workaround.

it does apply to test suites too, but i ran into some other side effects. the quarkus BOM (applied with enforcedPlatform) forced opentelemetry-api 1.23.1 onto the Quarkus test classpaths, and I think the file dependency change to make IntelliJ work added some build heap pressure. I reverted back to just the plugin change for now
